title: Te Hapori o te Hara Tuatahi
intro: I te whenua o ngā tāone tawhito, i tupu pai te iwi i mua. I tae atu tētahi karere ki a rātou me te karanga mārama, heoi i tahuri ke atu rātou, ā, i whai i tētahi ara kāore anō kia haerea e tētahi. Ko tā rātou kōrero he kōrero whakakeke, he whanoke, he whiu i wehe atu i tō rātou whenua tupu hei tohu mō te hunga katoa e whakaaroaro ana. Ko wai ēnei wairua?
clues: I noho mātou i ngā tāone o te mania, i te wāhi i karanga ai tō mātou poropiti i a mātou ki te tika.
Ko mātou te tuatahi ki te mahi i te mea whakarihariha kāore anō kia mahia e tetahi tangata i te ao katoa i mua.
I arai mātou i ngā tāngata haere, i mahi nui hoki i te kino i roto i ā mātou huihuinga.
I whakakahoretia e mātou te karere i tonoa mai ki a mātou, ā, i whakawehi mātou ki te pei i a ia i tō mātou whenua.
I oma tere mātou ki tōna whare ki te tono kia tukua mai āna manuhiri ki a mātou.
Ko tā mātou whiu he ua kōhatu, ā, kua hurihia tō mātou tāone ki raro.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I mahia te mahi tuatahi o te moepuku
I tinihangatia i roto i te hokohoko
I patua e rātou tā rātou poropiti
I whakakeke ki ō rātou mātua
trial.answer: I mahia te mahi tuatahi o te moepuku

outcome.label: Hua
options: I uaina ki ngā kōhatu, ā, i hurihia
I whakangaromia e te hau kaha
I pāngia e te pahūtanga nui
outcome.answer: I uaina ki ngā kōhatu, ā, i hurihia

verse: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. (26:162)
